witness_description: P(x)=Q(x)=1+4x+5x^2+11x^3; each coefficient sequence (1,4,5,11) is strictly increasing and hence unimodal.
refutation_explanation: P(x)Q(x)=1+8x+26x^2+62x^3+113x^4+110x^5+121x^6. Its coefficients rise to 113, fall to 110, and then rise to 121, so they are not unimodal.
search_space: All 108900 ordered pairs of degree-3 polynomials whose coefficient tuples are strictly increasing 4-element combinations from {1,2,...,11}, in lexicographic order; every product was checked using exact integer convolution.
